_comment: Canonical source for the settings matrix. One object per real user-facing/persisted setting. Rendered to SETTINGS_MATRIX.md by Scripts/generate-settings-matrix.py, which ALSO verifies this key set exactly matches the settings actually present in Sources/ (no orphaned or missing setting). Do not hand-edit SETTINGS_MATRIX.md.

settings.label: Menu bar item enabled
settings.effect: Inserts/removes the Core Bloom menu-bar item live.

settings.label: App language override
settings.consumer: L10n.swift (LocalizationManager), CoreTendApp.swift (.id() on the window + menu-bar content), SettingsView.swift picker, OnboardingView.swift Welcome-step picker
settings.effect: Overrides which .lproj bundle L() looks strings up in, independent of the system locale; "system" preserves the original Bundle.module resolution exactly.

settings.label: Onboarding completed
settings.effect: When false, the first-run onboarding is shown on launch; set true on completion.

settings.label: Onboarding step index
settings.effect: Persists progress through the onboarding wizard so it resumes at the same step.

settings.label: Excluded paths
settings.effect: Paths the user has excluded are never included in cleanup/care findings.

settings.label: Security profile
settings.consumer: OnboardingView.swift (persists the first-run wizard profile choice)
settings.effect: Records which security profile the user picked at first run. Informational; every profile keeps the fixed Trash, protected-root and explicit-confirmation safety posture.

settings.label: Notification: low disk space
settings.consumer: SettingsView.swift toggle; NotificationService.swift (NotificationPreferences) gates the low-disk-space local notification
settings.effect: When off, CoreTend never sends the low-disk-space local notification. Delivery still also requires granted notification permission.

settings.label: Notification: scheduled scan results
settings.consumer: SettingsView.swift toggle; NotificationService.swift gates the 'scheduled scan found meaningful reclaimable space' notification
settings.effect: When off, a completed scheduled scan never triggers the reclaimable-space notification.

settings.label: Notification: storage growth
settings.consumer: SettingsView.swift toggle; NotificationService.swift gates the 'tracked storage grew since the previous comparable scan' notification (delivered coalesced with scan results)
settings.effect: When off, a scheduled scan never triggers the storage-growth notification.
